declared_method_completions.fitness_normalization: population min-max; all equal maps to one
declared_method_completions.diversity: mean normalized symmetric-difference distance over occupied-cell sets
declared_method_completions.stagnation: fraction of population no better than its row-aligned parent
declared_method_completions.crossover: uniform occupied-cell gene choice from two tournament-selected parents
declared_method_completions.mutation: per-individual Bernoulli 0.1 then one cell replacement
declared_method_completions.power_law: truncated inverse-CDF integer displacement with exponent 2.5
declared_method_completions.repair: sort, remove duplicates, then deterministic cyclic fill
declared_method_completions.selection: three elites plus stable best remaining offspring
declared_method_completions.terminal_budget: evaluate an exact partial offspring batch when fewer than 30 physical FES remain

physical_fes: one complete layout evaluation over the selected case's 16 x 7 joint wind states counts as one physical FES; WS1, WS2, WS3, and WS4 are separate benchmark cases
claim_boundary: Bounded declared reconstruction only. Original PPGA transition details and original Nantong result claims remain blocked.
